summary_en: 2.7M shares (9.2% of S/O) to be acquired at ¥1,688/share via ToSTNeT-3, total cost ¥4.56B. Purchase results to be published 31 August 2026 post-market. Price fixed at market close 28 August 2026.
title_en: Notice of Fixed Purchase Price for Treasury Stock Acquisition via Off-Floor Transaction (ToSTNeT-3)
translation_en_brief: Sanyo Shokai announced on 28 August 2026 that the purchase price for its treasury stock acquisition via ToSTNeT-3 off-floor transaction has been fixed at ¥1,688 per share, following the close of trading that day. The company will acquire up to 2.7 million shares, representing 9.2% of shares outstanding (excluding treasury), for a total outlay of ¥4.56 billion. The purchase price was set at the market close. Results of the acquisition will be published on 31 August 2026 after market close. The filing notes that the percentage is calculated after reflecting a planned 1-for-3 stock split effective 1 September 2026 and incorporates 52,600 shares already acquired between 1 and 24 August 2026. Execution is subject to market conditions; partial or full acquisition may not occur.
